summary: Header, Part III amounts, the whole fixed schedule grid, all 3 Others rows and all four Part IV payment rows print correctly, but items 10/11 print blank despite being filled, row 7's Novel Tobacco money cells never print, and the Others-specify particulars cell clips text at its left edge.

defects.where: Page 1, items 10 Place of Production and 11 Place of Removal (Region/Province/City cells)
defects.what: All six cells print blank even though the selects were filled (PSGC 130000000/137600000/137602000) and validation accepted them; the strings appear nowhere in the generated sheet.html, so the binding is missing entirely. Checked by hand against the rendered preview and the app's own saved PDF - identical blanks.

defects.where: Page 3, Schedule 1 row 7 Novel Tobacco Products (XT210/XT220), Export/Taxable/Due cells
defects.what: Both money cells for rows 7a (Effective Aug 10 2022 / Jan 1 2023) and 7b Vapor-row equivalent print blank while every other fixed row prints its filled values; the _7A/_7B fields accepted fills on screen.

Fields txtSched1_*_2020_* and txtSched1_*_2021_* accept values but the paper only prints 'Effective January 1, 2022', 'Effective January 1, 2023' and a '2024 Onwards' note row - two years of filled cells silently never reach the print.

defects.where: Page 1, Part IV Others (specify) Particulars cell
defects.what: Entered 'MISC PAYMENT' prints as 'C PAYMENT' - the left edge of the text is clipped out of the cell (bank, number, date and amount all print fine).

Same stuck 'Unsaved changes' flag as 2200S: after editing via the row editor and saving through the draft, the header kept 'Unsaved changes' and Print preview ignored three clicks; dismissing and reopening the saved draft fixed it.
Bracket prints 'PER PACK' uppercased (entered 'Per Pack'); cosmetic only.

entered_by_hand: Opened Schedule 1 row 1a 'Effective January 1, 2022' editor and typed Tax Base Taxable 6,111,222.33 (prints on page 2, XT010 row 1a 2022). Also hand-verified the blank places cells and blank row-7 cells in the preview window and the saved PDF - checked by hand once more as required.
open_questions: Is the places blankness the same missing binding as 2200S PSIC - both are select/computed-style fields that validate fine but never reach sheet.html?
